name: McDONALD, Susan Eileen

headline.note: Official records establish Queensland ministerial chief-of-staff work from 2012 to 2014 and business management from 2014 to 2019. Employer, industry and first-person material identify a longer accounting career and Susan McDonald's operation of Super Butcher, but do not publish the earlier accounting employers, complete dates, hours, leave or transitions. Political staff, party roles, governance and elected office are excluded. Senior accounting and managing-director titles do not alone prove full-time service, so no public/private total is calculated.

career_spells.role: Bachelor of Commerce and Bachelor of Economics student
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography and member profile list both UQ degrees but no attendance or completion dates.

McDonald's profile identifies her as a qualified accountant. Contemporary 2016–19 professional biographies describe more than 20 years of accountancy and business-management experience, while an alumni profile says she worked as an accountant for various Brisbane businesses before ministerial staffing. Employers, roles, commencement, hours, leave and exact cessation are unpublished.
career_spells.counting_note: A professional qualification and aggregate experience claim do not establish employer-specific full-time intervals.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Queensland Minister for Natural Resources and Mines, Andrew Cripps MP
career_spells.evidence_note: The official federal biography gives a Queensland Government chief-of-staff interval from 2012 to 2014. A 2013 Queensland parliamentary document identifies McDonald as Chief of Staff to Natural Resources and Mines Minister Andrew Cripps. Some later profiles extend the role to 2015; exact appointment/cessation, hours and any overlap with Super Butcher require resolution.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded irrespective of public funding.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives business management from 2014 to 2019. Member and contemporary profiles identify McDonald as Managing Director of family-owned Super Butcher, responsible for five or six stores and roughly 80–100 staff. ABC says she took over the chain in 2012, while the official interval starts in 2014; exact title transition, payroll/self-employment status, hours, leave and election cessation are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Substantial private business work is supported, but the conflicting start and missing full-time/leave evidence prevent counting.

career_spells.employer: National Party of Queensland / Liberal National Party of Queensland
career_spells.role: State Secretary and later founding trustee
career_spells.evidence_note: Public profiles report a term as National Party state secretary beginning in 2003 and appointment as a founding LNP trustee after the 2008 merger. Exact dates, paid status, hours and overlap with accounting work are not established.

career_spells.employer: Beef Australia and Royal National Agricultural and Industrial Association of Queensland
career_spells.role: Director / council member and RNA treasurer
career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporary profiles record Beef Australia board and RNA council appointments in 2016 and later identify McDonald as RNA treasurer. End dates, remuneration and time commitment are not established.
career_spells.counting_note: Governance roles are excluded from substantive full-time employment totals.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary service began on 1 July 2019 following election to the Senate.
